what_it_is: Smooth and stable, comprehensive coiling solution
indications: Intended for the endovascular embolization of intracranial aneurysms, other neurovascular abnormalities such as AVMs and AVFs, and arterial and venous embolizations in the peripheral vasculature
use_notes:
Method of Detachment: Electrolytic, InZone detachment system
Coil Type: 360 XL Standard, 360 XL Soft, 360 Standard, 360 Soft, 360 Ultra, 360 Nano, 3D Standard, Helical XL Soft, Helical Ultra, Helical Nano
